original_page_visual_review.scope: Entire actual source page: all prose/quoted history, every inline/display equation and bound, factor/distribution/residue table cell, algorithm branch/update, figure node/edge/curve/caption, original footnote and exercise symbols where present.

bilingual_review.scope: Actual corresponding English source images inspected; complete matching prose, formulas, algorithms, numeric fields, captions and figure labels compared. Original Chinese figure placement retained before following prose.
bilingual_review.qualification: Book historical experiments are retained as historical claims; finite recomputation does not prove global distributions, convergence, primality theorems or untested experiments.

rendered_proof.qualification: Standalone eight-page proof, not whole-volume/final site acceptance.
